paragraphs: I’m an undergrad studying mathematical physics at the University of Melbourne.
My interests sit at the intersection of theoretical physics, scientific computing, and quantitative sport analytics applications.
Each day I learn more about careers where hard maths problems and real research take place.
I use Python, NumPy, SciPy and Jupyter, Rust when speed matters, and LaTeX for write-ups. Off the clock: French, hockey, bass and oat magics.
